'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[Attacks in Russia during the Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
***[[Ukraine]] launches a wave of drone strikes in Russia for a second consecutive day, causing a fire at a [[Rosneft]] [[oil refinery]] in [[Ryazan Oblast]], while a Ukrainian drone is reportedly shot down near [[Kinef|Kirishi refinery]] in [[Leningrad Oblast]]. [[President of Russia|Russian President]] [[Vladimir Putin]] says the attacks are an attempt to disrupt the upcoming [[2024 Russian presidential election|presidential election]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/ukraine-launches-drone-attacks-russia-second-night-row-officials-say-2024-03-13/ (Reuters)]
**[[Attacks on civilians in the Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
***Two people are killed and at least eight others are injured in a [[Russia]]n [[drone warfare|drone attack]] on an apartment building in [[Sumy]]. [https://kyivindependent.com/update-russian-attack-on-residential-building-in-sumy-kills-1-person-injures-8/ (''The Kyiv Independent'')]
**[[List of military aid to Ukraine during the Russo-Ukrainian War|Military aid to Ukraine during the Russo-Ukrainian War]]
***The [[European Union]] agrees to provide an additional [[€]]5 billion to their [[Ukraine|Ukrainian]] military aid fund. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/eu-agrees-5-bln-euro-boost-ukraine-military-aid-fund-2024-03-13/ (Reuters)]
*[[Piracy off the coast of Somalia]]
**[[Operation Atalanta]]
***The [[European Union]]'s counter-piracy mission says that one of its warships is currently shadowing the hijacked [[Bangladesh]]i [[bulk carrier]] {{MV|Abdullah||2}} as it sails toward the coast of [[Somalia]]. At least 23 crew members are being held hostage by pirates on the ship. [https://apnews.com/article/somalia-piracy-bangladesh-vessel-seized-e2c44611f12d85b2213cea627285a8c4 (AP)]
*[[Haitian crisis (2018–present)|Haitian crisis]]
**The [[United States]] deploys a [[Marine Corps Security Force Regiment]] [[platoon]] to secure the U.S. embassy complex in [[Port-au-Prince]], [[Haiti]]. [https://www.nbcnews.com/news/us-news/marines-deployed-haiti-us-embassy-security-gang-violence-rcna143123 (NBC News)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*Seven people are killed and 27 others are injured in an explosion caused by a suspected [[gas leak]] at a restaurant in [[Langfang]], [[Hebei Province]], [[China]]. [https://www.chinadaily.com.cn/a/202403/13/WS65f11ddea31082fc043bc694.html (''China Daily'')] [https://www.chinadailyhk.com/article/381220 (''China Daily'')]
*Sixteen [[SWAT]] officers are injured in an explosion at a [[training center]] in [[Orange County, California|Orange County]], [[California]], [[United States]]. [https://abcnews.go.com/amp/US/wireStory/people-injured-law-enforcement-training-facility-southern-california-108100769 (ABC News)]

'''Law and crime'''
*The [[Government of the United Kingdom|British government]] announces that it will ban foreign state ownership of [[List of newspapers in the United Kingdom|newspapers]] amid a controversial bid by a [[United Arab Emirates]]-led [[consortium]] to take over the [[Telegraph Media Group]], which publishes ''[[The Daily Telegraph]]''. [https://apnews.com/article/telegraph-spectator-foreign-state-ownership-ban-859bfcb3afd849e3cf388cf1fab32f41 (AP)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2023–2024 Dutch cabinet formation]]
**[[Party for Freedom]] leader [[Geert Wilders]] abandons his bid to become the next [[Prime Minister of the Netherlands]] citing a lack of support from other political parties in coalition formation talks. Wilders led his party to a surprise victory in the [[2023 Dutch general election]] with 37 seats. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-68557036 (BBC News)]
